containerOverrides.name: learning-lab-runner
command: const credentialUrl = process.env.AWS_CONTAINER_CREDENTIALS_RELATIVE_URI ? 'http://169.254.170.2' + process.env.AWS_CONTAINER_CREDENTIALS_RELATIVE_URI : process.env.AWS_CONTAINER_CREDENTIALS_FULL_URI; const probes = [['ec2-imds', 'http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/'], ['unrelated-link-local', 'http://169.254.169.123/'], ['ecs-task-metadata', process.env.ECS_CONTAINER_METADATA_URI_V4], ['task-role-credentials', credentialUrl]]; const ambientCredentialNames = ['AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID', 'AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY', 'AWS_SESSION_TOKEN'].filter((name) => process.env[name]); (async () => { let failed = ambientCredentialNames.length > 0; console.log(JSON.stringify({ name: 'ambient-credential-environment', exposed: failed, variableNames: ambientCredentialNames })); for (const [name, url] of probes) { if (!url) { console.log(JSON.stringify({ name, exposed: false, reason: 'environment variable absent' })); continue; } try { const response = await fetch(url, { signal: AbortSignal.timeout(2000) }); let keys = []; try { keys = Object.keys(await response.json()); } catch {} console.log(JSON.stringify({ name, exposed: true, status: response.status, keys })); failed = true; } catch (error) { console.log(JSON.stringify({ name, exposed: false, error: error.name })); } } if (failed) process.exitCode = 1; })();
